awards.label: Best Overall
awards.why: Three local-only Eve sensors with 784 reviews at 4.2 stars.

awards.label: Best Budget
awards.why: $27.99, the most reviews of any Matter contact sensor, and remote alarm support.

awards.label: Best Single
awards.why: One Eve sensor for $29.95 if you only need to watch one door.

products.verdict: The Matter door sensor to get. Local only, no account, and it works on every major platform.
pros: No Eve cloud, registration, or tracking
Open-time and duration statistics in the Eve app
cons: Statistics need the Eve app for iOS

products.verdict: Aqara's native Matter sensor, the cheapest and most-reviewed one here, with mixed ratings.
pros: Voice alerts through Siri, Alexa, and Google
cons: Some features need the Aqara app

products.verdict: A single Eve sensor for one door or window.
cons: Costs more per sensor than the 3-pack

avoid.verdict: The listing is a list of logos: no battery type, no battery life, no size, and no mounting details.
reasons: Each bullet is a single phrase like "Works with Apple Home" with no specifications.
Battery type, battery life, and size aren't listed anywhere.
The Aqara P2 costs less and has a real listing and over a thousand reviews.
